proposals.title: Pin-safe memory-tier eviction (rewrite FR-024)
proposals.current_state: FR-024 documents sparse-probe + shard-targeted blind-LRU-primary (evict_lru_for_key(target_key)) with a blind-LRU fallback that removes the dispatch-map entry on failed transition (data loss accepted).
proposals.proposed_resolution: Rewrite FR-024: evict_for_space frees one pin-safe victim per iteration via evict_one_clean over a widening oldest_keys(4*attempts, cap 1024) scan; demote (try_evict_to_block) or drop (dm.remove) only unpinned entries; dispatch-map transition before DRAM free; blind evict_lru/evict_lru_for_key fallback removed; returns AllocationFailed if all candidates pinned (caller leaves uncached or uses staging per FR-053). Update US7 scenarios, Edge Cases, and 2026-05-22/2026-05-08 clarifications accordingly.
proposals.rationale: Blind-free was a data-corruption bug under TP (freeing a slot an in-flight load pointed at). Fix is intentional and regression-tested (eviction_never_frees_pinned_slot); spec's data-loss-accepted fallback is now wrong.

proposals.title: Per-device warm stream (update FR-037)
proposals.current_state: FR-037 states a single warm CUDA stream stored as AtomicU64, multi-stream reserved for future.
proposals.proposed_resolution: Amend FR-037: the AtomicU64 warm_stream is now a fallback; the warm hot path and D2H populate path resolve the destination GPU device from the IPC pointer and use the per-device warm stream from DEVICE_STREAMS (cross-reference FR-052).
proposals.rationale: Multi-GPU / tensor-parallel support forced the single-stream model to per-device. Code is authoritative.

proposals.title: Concurrent-promotion-race recovery
proposals.current_state: Unspecced. FR-039 does not cover two concurrent lookups racing to promote the same cold key.
proposals.proposed_resolution: Add FR-051: a batch_lookup promotion that loses the mt.insert race (MemoryTierError::AlreadyExists) is mapped to DispatcherError::AlreadyExists and recovered by serve_concurrently_promoted, which bounded-waits (<=5s, 50us backoff) for the winner's MemoryTier transition and serves the resident slot via serve_memory_tier_to_gpu; timeout -> KeyNotFound, MismatchSize -> InvalidParameter. Add SC-015.
proposals.rationale: Regression-tested (batch_lookup_recovers_from_concurrent_promotion_race); prevents an engine crash under TP where sibling ranks request the same content-hash key.

proposals.title: Per-GPU-device CUDA stream routing (multi-GPU)
proposals.current_state: Unspecced. Spec assumes a single GPU/stream.
proposals.proposed_resolution: Add FR-052: cold and warm DMA transfers use CUDA streams bound to the destination GPU device via the process-global DEVICE_STREAMS map (device_streams_for); device resolved per request from the IPC pointer (device_of_ptr/set_batch_device) and made current; batch_lookup resolves one device per batch; cold_pool::ColdReadRequest.gpu_device drives set_device in the worker; unknown device (-1) falls back to shared streams.
proposals.rationale: Required for tensor-parallel deployments spanning multiple local GPUs; a stream on another GPU fails cudaMemcpyAsync with 'invalid argument'. Code is authoritative.

proposals.title: Cold-load staging pool
proposals.current_state: Unspecced. A cold load that could not obtain a memory-tier slot previously failed with AllocationFailed, crashing the client under bursts of concurrent cold reads.
proposals.proposed_resolution: Add FR-053: bounded StagingPool of cold_staging_slots pinned+registered host DRAM buffers of cold_staging_buf_bytes each (RAII StagingLease). On tier saturation a cold BlockDevice load is served SSD->staging->GPU (serve_cold_staged) and left as BlockDevice (uncached, not promoted) instead of failing; batch_lookup defers such entries to a lock-free one-lease-at-a-time post-pass. Amend FR-033 to add cold_staging_slots (usize, default 64) and cold_staging_buf_bytes (usize, default 4 MiB); 0 slots disables staging.
proposals.rationale: Prevents fatal AllocationFailed load failures under memory-tier saturation; mirrors the interfaces-crate DispatcherConfig backfill. Code is authoritative.

proposals.title: Cold-read drain-to-completion / no early break
proposals.current_state: Unspecced robustness. FR-019 does not describe pipeline error/completion draining; the paths previously broke early on the first error.
proposals.proposed_resolution: Add FR-054: pipelined_ssd_to_gpu_zero_copy and pipelined_multi_object_zero_copy MUST drain until completed==submitted and MUST NOT break early on error; on error set stop_submitting (submit no new reads, mark un-submitted work failed) but keep draining outstanding completions; return the first error. Breaking early orphans completions in the client's SPSC ring and deadlocks the next client reusing the NVMe queue.
proposals.rationale: Fixes a client hang from orphaned in-flight reads; complements FR-019 and US11 scenario 4. Code is authoritative.

proposals.title: Method inventory missing 8 shipped IDispatcher methods
proposals.current_state: FR-001 listed only initialize/shutdown/lookup/lookup_async/batch_lookup/check/remove/populate/touch/promote_to_memory_tier. IDispatcher (idispatcher.rs) also defines reserve_memory, copy_gpu_to_memory_async, copy_gpu_to_memory_completed, release_memory, pin, unpin, flush_to_ssd, read_write_stats.
proposals.proposed_resolution: Backfill FR-001 to the full shipped inventory grouped by role; cross-reference new FR-056.
proposals.rationale: Interface evolved; all methods ship and are used. Code is authoritative.

proposals.title: batch_lookup signature evolved to multi-region scatter
proposals.current_state: Spec: batch_lookup(entries: &[(CacheKey, IpcHandle)]). Code: &[(CacheKey, Vec<IpcHandle>)] (idispatcher.rs:377-380) — one key scatters to multiple GPU destinations.
proposals.proposed_resolution: Backfill FR-039 signature to &[(CacheKey, Vec<IpcHandle>)] with a multi-region-scatter note.
proposals.rationale: Sibling tensor-parallel ranks receive the same key into multiple destinations in one batch. Code is authoritative.

proposals.title: create_eviction_channel gained a capacity argument
proposals.current_state: Spec: create_eviction_channel() -> Receiver<EvictionEvent>. Code: create_eviction_channel(capacity: usize) (dispatcher/src/lib.rs:378-385); crossbeam bounded(capacity).
proposals.proposed_resolution: Backfill FR-042 to include the capacity parameter.
proposals.rationale: Caller now sizes the bounded channel. Code is authoritative.

proposals.title: Unspecced DispatcherConfig fields and IDispatcher memory-lifecycle primitives
proposals.current_state: DispatcherConfig has metadata_partition_size, extended_metadata_partition_size (idispatcher.rs:64,67) and backfill_delay_ms (:61, p2p-only). IDispatcher exposes reserve/copy/complete/release/pin/unpin/flush_to_ssd/read_write_stats with no requirement.
proposals.proposed_resolution: Extend FR-033 with the three config fields (noting backfill_delay_ms is p2p-only) and add FR-056 documenting the GPU-staged memory-lifecycle primitives plus flush_to_ssd/read_write_stats.
proposals.rationale: Shipped, load-bearing config and API surface with no spec coverage. Code is authoritative.

proposals.title: Interface doc advertises a nonexistent Creusot proof tree
proposals.current_state: idispatcher.rs:185-198 claimed invariants P1-P8 are 'formally proved with Creusot' in components/dispatcher/verif/ with '24 verification conditions discharged by SMT solvers'. No verif/ directory and no Creusot proofs exist. Per-method docs carried '# Verified: Pn' headings.
proposals.proposed_resolution: Soften the doc: reframe P1-P10 as informal design invariants (exercised by tests, not machine-checked), explicitly note the removed false claim, and change the 16 per-method '# Verified:' headings to '# Design invariants (informal, not machine-checked):'. Doc-only ALIGN edit; no behavior change.
proposals.rationale: Interface docs asserted verification that was never present; correcting the claim is low-risk and prevents false assurance. This is a doc-accuracy fix, not a HIGH code-behavior bug, so applied directly on the branch per the soften-doc decision.
proposals.verification: cargo build -p interfaces clean after edits.
